theorems.name: Submission.variation_param_integral_deriv
theorems.statement: ∀ (α X : Type) [MeasurableSpace α] [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace ℝ X] (μ : Measure α) (S : Set α) (C : Set X) (e : α → X) (g : ℝ × X → ℝ), MeasurableSet S → μ S < ⊤ → IsCompact C → (∀ z ∈ S, e z ∈ C) → AEStronglyMeasurable e (μ.restrict S) → ((∀ x ∈ C, ContDiffAt ℝ 1 g (0, x)) → (∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 0, Integrable (fun z ↦ g (t, e z)) (μ.restrict S)) ∧ HasDerivAt (fun t ↦ ∫ z in S, g (t, e z) ∂μ) (∫ z in S, deriv (fun t ↦ g (t, e z)) 0 ∂μ) 0) ∧ ((∀ x ∈ C, ContDiffAt ℝ 2 g (0, x)) → (∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 0, HasDerivAt (fun s ↦ ∫ z in S, g (s, e z) ∂μ) (∫ z in S, deriv (fun s ↦ g (s, e z)) t ∂μ) t) ∧ HasDerivAt (fun t ↦ ∫ z in S, deriv (fun s ↦ g (s, e z)) t ∂μ) (∫ z in S, deriv (fun t ↦ deriv (fun s ↦ g (s, e z)) t) 0 ∂μ) 0)
